function shortTripFit(d){
  if(quickBreakFit[d.city]!=null)return quickBreakFit[d.city];
  if(d.travelEffort===1)return 3.2;
  if(d.travelEffort===2)return 2.8;
  return 1.5;
}
function destinationBoxesForTrip(d){
  if((answers[1]??0)!==0)return d.boxes;
  return [...new Set([...(d.boxes||[]),...(quickBreakExtraBoxes[d.city]||[])])];
}

function track(event,props={}){window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];window.dataLayer.push({event,...props});console.info('[analytics]',event,props)}
function haptic(pattern=30){try{navigator.vibrate?.(pattern)}catch(e){}}
function go(id){document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');window.scrollTo(0,0);track('screen_view',{screen:id,mode:playMode})}

function startGame(){playMode='match';qIndex=0;answers=[];result=null;personaId='capybara';track('game_started',{mode:'match'});renderQuestion();go('question')}
function startFate(){playMode='fate';qIndex=0;answers=[];result=null;personaId=null;track('game_started',{mode:'fate'});renderQuestion();go('question')}
function activeQuestions(){return playMode==='fate'?fateQuestions:questions}
function renderQuestion(){const qs=activeQuestions(),q=qs[qIndex];document.getElementById('questionModeLabel').textContent=playMode==='fate'?'命運 Fast Lane':'旅行小測驗';document.getElementById('stepnum').textContent=`${qIndex+1} / ${qs.length}`;document.getElementById('progressbar').style.width=`${((qIndex+1)/qs.length)*100}%`;document.getElementById('questionKicker').textContent=q.k;document.getElementById('questionTitle').textContent=q.t;document.getElementById('questionSub').textContent=q.s;document.getElementById('alienBubble').textContent=playMode==='fate'?(qIndex<3?'只問去得成需要嘅條件，其餘我唔問。':'四題完成就直接開命運盒。'):q.bubble;document.getElementById('encourage').innerHTML=playMode==='fate'?(qIndex===3?'<b>答完即抽，唔分析動物人格。</b>':q.e):q.e.replace('盲盒','<b>盲盒</b>');const c=document.getElementById('choices');c.innerHTML='';q.o.forEach((o,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='choice'+(answers[qIndex]===i?' selected':'');b.innerHTML=`<span class="iconbox">${iconSVG(o[0])}</span><span><b>${o[1]}</b><small>${o[2]}</small></span>`;b.onclick=()=>pickChoice(i);c.appendChild(b)})}
function pickChoice(i){if(isTransitioning)return;answers[qIndex]=i;renderQuestion();haptic(20);track('question_completed',{mode:playMode,index:qIndex+1,answer:i});isTransitioning=true;setTimeout(()=>{isTransitioning=false;const qs=activeQuestions();if(qIndex<qs.length-1){qIndex++;renderQuestion()}else if(playMode==='fate'){track('fate_constraints_completed');enterFateOpen()}else{personaId=calculatePersona();renderBoxes();track('quiz_completed',{persona:personaId});go('boxes')}},330)}
function prevQuestion(){if(qIndex===0)go('home');else{qIndex--;renderQuestion()}}
function backToLastQuestion(){playMode='match';qIndex=questions.length-1;renderQuestion();go('question')}
function calculatePersona(){const s=Object.fromEntries(personaOrder.map(p=>[p,0]));const apply=(arr,idx)=>{const m=arr[idx]||{};Object.entries(m).forEach(([p,v])=>s[p]+=v)};apply(personaScore.q5,answers[4]??0);apply(personaScore.q6,answers[5]??0);apply(personaScore.q7,answers[6]??0);apply(personaScore.q8,answers[7]??0);return [...personaOrder].sort((a,b)=>(s[b]-s[a])||(personaOrder.indexOf(a)-personaOrder.indexOf(b)))[0]}
function recommendation(){const ids=['city','nature','island','food','photo','culture','fun'],s=Object.fromEntries(ids.map(id=>[id,0]));const moodMap=['nature','food','city','photo','culture','fun'],behMap=['city','food','culture','culture','island','fun'];s[moodMap[answers[4]??0]]+=4.2;s[behMap[answers[6]??0]]+=3.4;const pace=answers[5]??0;if(pace===0){s.nature+=1.5;s.island+=1.2;s.city+=.5}else if(pace===1){s.city+=.8;s.culture+=.7;s.photo+=.5}else if(pace===2){s.fun+=1.8;s.city+=.4}else{s.fun+=.8;s.city+=.7;s.culture+=.6}const pm={capybara:{nature:1.8,city:.5,island:.7},bear:{food:2.2},cat:{city:2,photo:.8},turtle:{island:2.3,nature:1},otter:{fun:2,city:.5},fox:{culture:1.4,photo:.9,nature:.7},owl:{culture:2.2},shiba:{fun:2.3}};Object.entries(pm[personaId]||{}).forEach(([id,v])=>s[id]+=v);const id=ids.sort((a,b)=>s[b]-s[a]||ids.indexOf(a)-ids.indexOf(b))[0];return boxData.find(b=>b.id===id)||boxData[0]}
function renderBoxes(){const rec=recommendation();document.getElementById('recommendBox').innerHTML=`<div class="box-hero"><div class="box-art" style="background:${rec.c}">${iconSVG(rec.icon)}</div><div class="box-copy"><b>${rec.n}</b><p>${rec.d}</p><div class="tags">${rec.tags.map(t=>`<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div></div></div>`;document.getElementById('recommendBox').onclick=()=>chooseBox(rec.id);const grid=document.getElementById('boxGrid');grid.innerHTML='';boxData.filter(b=>b.id!==rec.id).forEach((b,idx)=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='box'+(b.id==='fate'?' fate':'');el.innerHTML=`${b.id==='fate'?'<span class="badge">最高驚喜</span>':idx===0?'<span class="badge">熱門</span>':''}<div class="boxico" style="background:${b.c}">${iconSVG(b.icon)}</div><b>${b.n}</b><p>${b.d}</p>`;el.onclick=()=>chooseBox(b.id);grid.appendChild(el)})}
function chooseBox(id){chosenBox=boxData.find(b=>b.id===id);prepareOpen();track('box_selected',{box:id,recommended:playMode==='match'&&recommendation().id===id,mode:playMode});go('openbox')}
function enterFateOpen(){chosenBox=boxData.find(b=>b.id==='fate');prepareOpen();go('openbox')}
function prepareOpen(){document.getElementById('chosenBoxName').textContent=chosenBox.n;document.getElementById('mysteryBox').classList.remove('opening');document.getElementById('mysteryStage').classList.remove('opening');document.getElementById('openBtn').disabled=false;document.getElementById('openBackBtn').textContent=playMode==='fate'?'我想改基本條件':'我想揀過另一盒'}
function returnFromOpen(){if(playMode==='fate'){qIndex=fateQuestions.length-1;renderQuestion();go('question')}else go('boxes')}
function practical(){return {companion:answers[0]??0,days:answers[1]??0,budget:answers[2]??0,distance:answers[3]??0}}
function eligibleDestination(d,boxId){const p=practical(),maxDays=dayRanges[p.days][1];if(d.tier==='Experimental')return false;if(d.recommendedDays[0]>maxDays)return false;if(d.costLevel-budgetCap[p.budget]>=2)return false;if(d.travelEffort>effortCap[p.distance])return false;if(p.days===0&&shortTripFit(d)<3)return false;if(boxId!=='fate'&&!destinationBoxesForTrip(d).includes(boxId))return false;return true}
function recentList(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('flylawei_recent')||'[]')}catch(e){return []}}
function repeatWeight(id){const i=recentList().indexOf(id);if(i<0)return 1;if(i<2)return .12;if(i<5)return .45;return 1}
function rememberDestination(id){try{let a=recentList().filter(x=>x!==id);a.unshift(id);localStorage.setItem('flylawei_recent',JSON.stringify(a.slice(0,5)))}catch(e){}}
function destinationScore(d,boxId){const p=practical(),comp=companionKeys[p.companion];let score=1;score+=(d.companionFit?.[comp]||3)*.45;score+=(d.primaryBox===boxId?2.4:(boxId==='fate'?0:1.1));const dr=dayRanges[p.days],mid=(dr[0]+dr[1])/2,dm=(d.recommendedDays[0]+d.recommendedDays[1])/2;score+=Math.max(0,1.4-Math.abs(mid-dm)*.22);score+=Math.max(0,1.2-Math.abs(budgetCap[p.budget]-d.costLevel)*.35);if(p.days===0)score+=(shortTripFit(d)-3)*1.55;if(playMode==='match'){const intDim=interestDims[answers[4]??0];score+=(d.scores?.[intDim]||0)*.75;const behDim=behaviorDims[answers[6]??0];score+=(d.scores?.[behDim]||0)*.62;const pace=answers[5]??0;if(pace===0)score+=(d.scores?.relax||0)*.5;else if(pace===1)score+=Math.max(0,1.8-Math.abs((d.paceLevel||2)-2)*.7);else if(pace===2)score+=(d.scores?.fun||0)*.5;else score+=(d.scores?.novelty||0)*.5;score+=(d.personaAffinity?.[personaId]||0)*.62}return Math.max(.25,score)}
function tierWeight(d,boxId){if(playMode==='fate')return ({Core:.55,Discovery:1.2,Hidden:1.6}[d.tier]||0);let tw=tierWeights[answers[7]??0][d.tier]||0;if(boxId==='fate')tw*=d.tier==='Hidden'?1.25:d.tier==='Discovery'?1.08:.9;return tw}
function weightedDestination(){const boxId=chosenBox.id;let pool=destinationMaster.filter(d=>eligibleDestination(d,boxId));if(!pool.length)pool=destinationMaster.filter(d=>eligibleDestination(d,'fate'));
/* v12.2 Match Quality Gate
   Surprise is applied only after weak-fit candidates are removed. */
const scored=pool.map(d=>({d,fit:destinationScore(d,boxId)}));
const bestFit=Math.max(...scored.map(x=>x.fit),0);
const qualityRatio=playMode==='fate'?.78:.82;
let qualified=scored.filter(x=>x.fit>=bestFit*qualityRatio);
if(!qualified.length&&scored.length)qualified=[scored.sort((a,b)=>b.fit-a.fit)[0]];
const entries=qualified.map(x=>({d:x.d,fit:x.fit,w:x.fit*tierWeight(x.d,boxId)*repeatWeight(x.d.id)})).filter(x=>x.w>0);
const total=entries.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.w,0);
let r=Math.random()*total;
for(const x of entries){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){console.info('[match]',{mode:playMode,box:boxId,eligible:pool.length,qualified:entries.length,bestFit,qualityRatio,result:x.d.city,fit:x.fit,weight:x.w});return x.d}}
return entries.at(-1)?.d||qualified.at(-1)?.d||pool[0]}
function openMystery(){const mb=document.getElementById('mysteryBox'),stage=document.getElementById('mysteryStage');mb.classList.add('opening');stage.classList.add('opening');document.getElementById('openBtn').disabled=true;haptic([40,30,80]);track('box_opened',{box:chosenBox.id,mode:playMode});setTimeout(()=>{result=weightedDestination();startAnalysis()},1450)}
function startAnalysis(){go('analysis');const fate=playMode==='fate';document.getElementById('analysisSub').textContent=fate?'你俾咗我實際條件，其餘真係交俾命運。':'等我一次過幫你配對旅行人格同下一站。';const texts=fate?['確認基本條件…','開啟命運目的地池…','抽取下一站…','命運結果出爐！']:['掃描旅行 vibe…','比對旅行人格…','篩走唔合理目的地…','結果配對完成！'];let i=0;document.getElementById('analysisText').textContent=texts[0];const timer=setInterval(()=>{i++;if(i<texts.length)document.getElementById('analysisText').textContent=texts[i];else{clearInterval(timer);setTimeout(()=>showFinalResult(),260)}},500)}
function showFinalResult(){renderResult();rememberDestination(result.id);go('result');haptic([25,25,55]);if(playMode==='match')track('persona_revealed',{persona:personaId});track('destination_revealed',{city:result.city,persona:personaId||null,box:chosenBox.id,mode:playMode,tier:result.tier})}
function boxName(id){return boxData.find(b=>b.id===id)?.n||id}
function renderResult(){const d=result,isFate=playMode==='fate',p=isFate?null:personas[personaId],hidden=d.tier==='Hidden';document.getElementById('resultCity').textContent=d.city;document.getElementById('resultCountry').textContent=isFate?`${d.country}${hidden?' · ✦ 隱藏目的地解鎖':''}`:`${d.country} · ${p.vibe}`;document.getElementById('resultCode').textContent=d.gatewayCode;document.getElementById('sceneLabel').textContent=`${d.country} · ${d.city}`;document.getElementById('resultPersonaLabel').textContent=isFate?'你今次選擇':'你今次嘅旅行人格';document.getElementById('resultPersonaName').textContent=isFate?'命運玩家':p.name;document.getElementById('resultPersonaSignature').textContent=isFate?'唔分析人格，今次真係交俾命運。':personaSignatures[personaId];document.getElementById('resultAnimal').innerHTML=isFate?iconSVG('dice'):characterIMG(personaId,p.name);document.getElementById('resultTags').innerHTML=[chosenBox.n,...d.motifs.slice(0,2)].map(t=>`<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join('');const reasons=makeReasons(d,p);document.getElementById('reasons').innerHTML=reasons.map(r=>`<div class="reason"><span class="check">✓</span><span>${r}</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('shareAnimal').innerHTML=isFate?iconSVG('dice'):characterIMG(personaId,p.name);document.getElementById('sharePersonaLabel').textContent=isFate?'我今次係':'我原來係';document.getElementById('sharePersona').textContent=isFate?'命運玩家':p.name;document.getElementById('shareCity').textContent=d.city;document.getElementById('shareCode').textContent=d.gatewayCode;document.getElementById('shareVibe').textContent=`${chosenBox.n} · ${d.motifs.slice(0,2).join(' · ')}`;document.getElementById('shareTitle').innerHTML=isFate?'畀朋友睇下<span class="hot">命運送我去邊</span>':'畀朋友估下<span class="hot">佢又係咩動物</span>';document.getElementById('shareHook').textContent=isFate?'你敢唔敢直接交俾命運？':'你又係邊種旅行動物？'}
function makeReasons(d,p){const a=[];const isQuick=(answers[1]??0)===0;if(playMode==='fate'){a.push(`${d.city}通過咗你設定嘅日數、預算同飛行距離條件。`);a.push(isQuick?`你揀咗 2–3 日快閃，所以系統再優先留低落地後易玩、交通摩擦較低嘅目的地。`:`其餘偏好我冇問；今次真係喺合資格目的地入面交俾命運抽。`);return a}const mood=['放空散心','食好西','城市逛街','打卡靚景','文化探索','玩樂刺激'][answers[4]??0];a.push(`${d.city}喺「${chosenBox.n}」入面配對度高，亦符合你揀嘅「${mood}」。`);a.push(isQuick?`你揀咗 2–3 日快閃；系統先過短途實用性，再用「${p.name}」偏好做加權。`:`你嘅日數、預算同飛行距離全部過咗基本條件，再用「${p.name}」偏好做加權。`);return a}
function resultBack(){if(playMode==='fate'){qIndex=fateQuestions.length-1;renderQuestion();go('question')}else go('boxes')}
function resultAgain(){if(playMode==='fate'){chosenBox=boxData.find(b=>b.id==='fate');prepareOpen();go('openbox')}else go('boxes')}
function nativeShare(channel){const d=result,isFate=playMode==='fate',p=isFate?null:personas[personaId];const txt=isFate?`我直接交俾命運，飛啦喂！抽中 ${d.city} ✈️
你敢唔敢唔睇攻略先抽一次？`:`我原來係「${p.name}」！今次「飛啦喂！」抽中 ${d.city} ✈️
你又係邊種旅行動物？
下一站，等你一齊抽！`;track('share_clicked',{channel,city:d.city,persona:personaId||null,mode:playMode});if(navigator.share){navigator.share({title:'飛啦喂！旅行盲盒',text:txt,url:location.href}).catch(()=>{})}else{navigator.clipboard?.writeText(txt);showToast(`${channel} 分享文案已複製`)}}
function showToast(t){const el=document.getElementById('toast');el.textContent=t;el.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),1800)}
function restart(){qIndex=0;answers=[];result=null;personaId='capybara';track('replay_clicked',{mode:playMode});playMode='match';go('home')}
track('app_loaded',{build:'v13-visual-master-full-flow'});
</script>
</body>
</html>
